newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks seen steady on Wall Street.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks seen steady on Wall Street.

text.p: Jakarta stocks are seen steady on Monday, with Friday's gains on Wall Street and the local exchange seen keeping sentiment firm, brokers said.
"I think sentiment should remain firm after strong showings both on Wall Street and in the local market," one broker with a foreign brokerage firm said.
Brokers, however, said trading was likely to slow down due to the public holiday in Hong Kong as the colony reverts to China.
Many of the foreign investors active on the local stock exchange are based in Hong Kong, they said.
On Friday, the Jakarta Composite Index was up 7.42 points, or 1.05 percent, to 716.83 points.
